title: PLAYER 2 GETS CLOSE CALL
why: An enemy round that reached player 2 while his roll i-frames were up never paid CLOSE CALL: the host pays it only in his own round loop, and the hit word the host sends player 2 did not say it was a round, so player 2 took it straight into damagePlayer, which stops at the i-frames with no stamina back, no +25 and no callout. Proven with eval: rolling player 2 kept 10 stamina and the score did not move, while the host in the same spot gets 55 and +25. Now the host marks a round on player 2 with rd:1 (a blast or a bite stays unmarked, matching the host, who is paid only for a round), and player 2 calls closeCall before damagePlayer when the word says round. A standing player 2 takes the round exactly as before.
now: Player 2 now gets CLOSE CALL (stamina back and +25) when he rolls through an enemy round, just like player 1.

edits.replacement: function netHitPlayer(p,amt,src,srcName,sx,sy,rd){  // v16.xx (cloud-coop-p2-close-call), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: rd marks an enemy round, so player 2 can earn CLOSE CALL

m={t:'hit',seat:p.seat,dmg:+(+amt).toFixed(2),kind:netClean(src,16),name:netClean(srcName,24)}; if(LATCH_BITE) m.pi=1;   // crawlerlatch
  if(rd) m.rd=1;  // v16.xx (cloud-coop-p2-close-call), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a round, not a blast or a bite

if(dist(b,bd)<bd.r+3){ netHitPlayer(bd,b.dmg,(b.owner&&b.owner.kind)||'other',(b.owner&&b.owner.name)||'',b.x-b.vx*0.05,b.y-b.vy*0.05,1); return true; }  // v16.xx (cloud-coop-p2-close-call), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: this is a round

edits.anchor: LATCH_BITE=m.pi?1:0;   // crawlerlatch: a crawler hanging on him bites through his roll too
edits.replacement:
if(m.rd) try{ closeCall(null); }catch(_cc){}  // v16.xx (cloud-coop-p2-close-call), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a round reaching player 2 in his roll i-frames pays CLOSE CALL as it does the host
  LATCH_BITE=m.pi?1:0;   // crawlerlatch: a crawler hanging on him bites through his roll too
